composePanelCloseDiscard: Closing discards an unsent, unsaved draft
devicesNoInstallDesc: No download, no setup step — sign in and start reading.
devicesResponsiveDesc: The inbox, reading pane and composer adapt to phones and tablets.
devicesSubtitle: Dusrel Mail runs in your browser, so it works on desktop and mobile without installing anything.
devicesWebDesc: Open it on any device with a browser and your inbox is there.
downloadBadgeAppStore: App Store badge — asset coming later
downloadBadgeGooglePlay: Google Play badge — asset coming later
downloadSlotsNote: Download badges will be added here later.
faqA1: Pricing is not decided yet. This Phase 1 build is a demo — no payment is asked for, and no plan is promised here.
faqA2: End-to-end encryption and seed-phrase recovery are core to the design. In this Phase 1 build they are not yet connected to a real backend, so do not send real confidential mail through the demo.
faqA3: Aliases are part of the plan: hide your real address behind addresses you can add, manage and delete. Alias management is not in the Phase 1 build yet.
faqA4: Sign-up goes through the Account Centre and is invite-gated in Phase 1. Public sign-up is not open yet.
featureAliasesDesc: Hide your real address with aliases you can add, manage and delete.
featurePrivateDesc: Only you and your recipient can read an encrypted message.
featureProtectedDesc: Send confidential mail to anyone, even if they do not use Dusrel Mail.
featureSeedDesc: Your seed phrase restores your account. Keep it safe and private.
landingSubtitle: Dusrel Mail is the first Dusrel web app: a clean, private webmail with folders, aliases and password-protected mail. No ads, no tracking.
msgAutoDeleteNote: Emails kept in Junk/Trash for 30 days are automatically deleted permanently
msgNoAttachmentsData: Attachment information is not available for these messages.
msgNoEncryptedData: Encryption information is not available for these messages.
msgNothingFoundHint: Try to change search criteria or check spelling
pcProtectText: A recovery email helps you regain access if you lose your seed phrase.
pcTwoFactorNote: Real two-factor authentication is managed in the Account Centre.
privacyOnDeviceDesc: Decryption happens on your own device, not on a server.
privacySubtitle: Your mail stays yours. Encryption and recovery are built into the design, not added as an afterthought.
privacyZeroAccessDesc: Stored mail is kept in a form the provider cannot read.
secure2faDesc: Your account can require a second code, managed in the Account Centre.
secureAccountDesc: Password, two-factor authentication and sessions are managed in one place, in the Account Centre.
secureNoTrackDesc: No advertising and no behaviour tracking in your mailbox.
secureSpamDesc: Unwanted mail is kept out of your inbox, in its own folder.
secureSubtitle: The everyday protections that keep a busy inbox safe.
settingsNote: These are mail-only settings. Account settings such as password, two-factor authentication and sessions live in the Account Centre.
simpleSubtitle: The privacy tools you actually use, without a manual to read first.
spDeleteText: Account deletion is handled in the Account Centre. This panel cannot delete your account.
spHideNote: It will let you sign up for services without sharing your real address.
spHideSoon: Hide My Email is coming soon.
spNoAliases: You don't have any alias yet.
spPricingText: Dusrel hasn't decided pricing yet, so there is nothing to buy here. Plan options will appear when they are ready.
spReplyPlaceholder: Thanks for your message. I'll get back to you soon.
spSessionNote: Ending a session is managed in the Account Centre.
spSignatureNote: Appears at the end of every email you send.
